jobs.title: Team Leader - Testing (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You will define and implement the team's long-term vision, objectives, and testing strategy in alignment with departmental goals.
• You will plan, coordinate, and oversee functional validation programs on hydraulic component test benches.
• You will ensure high-quality validation standards and drive innovation by establishing and continuously improving testing methodologies and best practices.
• You will analyze test results and translate findings into actionable recommendations for product improvement.
• You will collaborate closely with Design Engineering, Quality, and Production teams to align testing priorities and support product development.
• You will develop and implement standardized testing procedures and data analysis methods to improve efficiency, reliability, and repeatability of validation activities.
• You will monitor project progress, resource allocation, and team performance, providing regular updates and recommendations to department management.
• You will ensure compliance with safety standards across all testing operations and laboratory activities. Your Profile
• You hold a degree in mechanical engineering, preferably with a specialization in mobile hydraulics, mobile machinery, drive systems, construction equipment or agricultural.
• You have proven experience in engineering development and validation, ideally in the field of hydraulic drive systems, mobile machinery or off-highway equipment.
• You possess deep knowledge in hydraulic drives, control systems, and functional validation methods, combined with a good understanding of machine functions and system behavior under real operating conditions.
• Leadership is a core aspect of your profile: you actively coach and empower your team, set clear priorities and ensure alignment with strategic objectives. You foster a high-performance culture, promote accountability and support your team in solving complex technical challenges.
• You combine strategic thinking with strong analytical skills, enabling you to solve complex technical challenges, support your team in root-cause analysis and drive sustainable improvements across products, test methods and processes.
• You communicate fluently in French and German, with a good command of English. Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 34 00

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le vostre responsabilità - Definirete e implementerete la visione, gli obiettivi e la strategia a lungo termine del team in linea con gli obiettivi del dipartimento. - Pianificherete, coordinerete e supervisionerete programmi di validazione funzionale sui banchi di prova per componenti idraulici. - Garantirete standard di validazione di alta qualità e guiderete l'innovazione attraverso l'istituzione e il miglioramento continuo delle metodologie di test e delle migliori pratiche. - Analizzarete i risultati dei test e tradurrete i risultati in raccomandazioni attuabili per il miglioramento dei prodotti.

- Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team di Design Engineering, Qualità e Produzione per allineare le priorità di test e sostenere lo sviluppo dei prodotti. - Svilupperai e implementerai procedure di test e metodi di analisi dei dati standardizzati per migliorare l'efficienza, l'affidabilità e la ripetibilità delle attività di validazione. - Moniturerai i progressi dei progetti, l'allocazione delle risorse e le prestazioni del team, fornendo aggiornamenti e raccomandazioni regolari alla gestione dei dipartimenti. - Assicurerai il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza in tutte le operazioni di test e attività di laboratorio.

Il tuo profilo - Hai una laurea in ingegneria meccanica, preferibilmente con una specializzazione in idraulica mobile, macchine mobili, sistemi di azionamento, attrezzature per la costruzione o agricola. - Hai una comprovata esperienza nello sviluppo e validazione ingegneristica, idealmente nel campo dei sistemi di azionamento idraulico, macchine mobili o attrezzature fuoristrada. - Si dispone di una conoscenza approfondita in azionamenti idraulici, sistemi di controllo, e metodi di validazione funzionale, combinata con una buona comprensione delle funzioni della macchina e del sistema Behavior in condizioni operative reali.

- La leadership è un aspetto fondamentale del tuo profilo: alleni attivamente e potenzia il tuo team, fissi priorità chiare e assicuri l'allineamento con obiettivi strategici. Favorisci una cultura ad alte prestazioni, promuove la responsabilità e supporta il tuo team nella risoluzione di complesse sfide tecniche. - Combina il pensiero strategico con forti capacità analitiche, consentendoti di risolvere complesse sfide tecniche, supportare il tuo team nell'analisi delle cause profonde e guidare miglioramenti sostenibili attraverso prodotti, metodi di test e processi. - Comunichi fluentemente in francese e tedesco, con un buon comando dell'inglese.

La nostra offerta - Possiamo ispirarvi ad assumere una posizione responsabile in un business familiare dinamico e indipendente? - Vi offriamo spazio per idee, un lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro moderne e familiari come orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio domestico, un ristorante aziendale, opportunità di formazione e molti benefici. - Il posto di lavoro si trova a Bulle, circondato dalla natura meravigliosa della regione di Gruyère. - Iniziate a pianificare il vostro sviluppo personale e professionale con noi.

Al fine di garantire un processo di applicazione equo - Non possiamo accettare le applicazioni per posta o e-mail.

Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? - Poi non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. - Se avete domande, si prega di contattare Sylvain STUDER.

L'Azienda - Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per motori a combustione (motori diesel e a gas) e componenti idraulici (pompe a pistoni assiali e motori). - L'azienda sviluppa e produce vari prodotti, che trovano il loro utilizzo in edilizia e ingegneria civile, mineraria, agricola, energetica decentrata, macchine e impiantistica, così come aerospaziale.

Ubicazione - Liebherr Machines Bulle SA - 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr - 1630 Bulle - Svizzera (CH)

descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihre Verantwortung - Sie definieren und implementieren die langfristige Vision, Ziele und Teststrategie des Teams in Übereinstimmung mit den Zielen der Abteilung. - Sie planen, koordinieren und überwachen funktionale Validierungsprogramme auf hydraulischen Bauteilprüfständen. - Sie gewährleisten hochwertige Validierungsstandards und treiben Innovationen durch die Etablierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Testmethoden und Best Practices. - Sie analysieren die Testergebnisse und übersetzen Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für Produktverbesserungen.

- Sie werden eng mit Design Engineering, Qualität und Produktion Teams zu koordinieren Testprioritäten und unterstützen die Produktentwicklung. - Sie entwickeln und implementieren standardisierte Testverfahren und Datenanalyse Methoden, um Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Wiederholbarkeit von Validierungsaktivitäten zu verbessern. - Sie werden Projektfortschritt, Ressourcenallokation und Teamleistung überwachen, Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Updates und Empfehlungen für Abteilungsmanagement. - Sie werden die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards für alle Testvorgänge und Laboraktivitäten gewährleisten.

Ihr Profil - Sie haben einen Abschluss in Maschinenbau, vorzugsweise mit einer Spezialisierung auf mobile Hydraulik, mobile Maschinen, Antriebssysteme, Baumaschinen oder landwirtschaftliche. - Sie haben Erfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung und Validierung, ideal im Bereich der hydraulischen Antriebssysteme, mobile Maschinen oder Off-Highway-Ausrüstung. - Sie verfügen über tiefe Kenntnisse in hydraulischen Antrieben, Steuerungen und funktionalen Validierungsmethoden, kombiniert mit einem guten Verständnis der Maschinenfunktionen und Systemverhalten unter realen Betriebsbedingungen.

- Führung ist ein Kernaspekt Ihres Profils: Sie trainieren und stärken Ihr Team aktiv, setzen klare Prioritäten und sorgen für eine Ausrichtung auf strategische Ziele. Sie fördern eine leistungsstarke Kultur, fördern die Rechenschaftspflicht und unterstützen Ihr Team bei der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen. - Sie verbinden strategisches Denken mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten, ermöglichen es Ihnen, komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, Ihr Team bei der Wurzel-Ursache-Analyse zu unterstützen und nachhaltige Verbesserungen über Produkte, Testmethoden und Prozesse hinweg voranzutreiben. - Sie kommunizieren fließend in Französisch und Deutsch, mit guter Englischkenntnissen.

• You are responsible for implementing organizational changes and process changes,
• You define and manage the execution of the product segment strategy,
• You manage the cost performance and associated reduction plans,
• You contribute to analysis and decision-making and the implementation of the "Make or Buy" measures.
• You support the management of the changes produced through purchasing actions,
• You are responsible for managing the risks of strategic procurement activities, supplier risks and product segments,
• You are responsible for benchmarking product portfolios,
• You are actively and proactively involved in internal problem-solving and supplier activities. Your Profile
• You benefit from technical or economic training supplemented by training in the field of procurement,
• You have a solid experience in strategic procurement in a technical field,
• You speak fluently French and have a very good level in English,
• You have mastered the MS Office suite, an intranet or an ERP,
• You are a flexible, self-reliant, reliable person and appreciate teamwork. Our offer Can we motivate you to take on a key role in a family, dynamic and independent business? We encourage you to share and develop your ideas and offer you a safe job, modern working conditions that are compatible with family life such as flexible working hours, the possibility of working in Home Office, a business restaurant, opportunities for continuing training and many other benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, in the beautiful Gruyère region. Plan your personal and professional development with us. This position is subject to a background check procedure, verification is done through our partner Aequivalent. In order to ensure a fair application procedure, we do not accept applications by mail or e-mail. Have we raised your interest? If so, we would be happy to receive your application online. If you have any questions, please contact Nadege MALAN. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *A common passion. So many opportunities. Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the competence centre for combustion engines (diesel and gas) and hydraulic components. The company develops and manufactures diversified products used in civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralized energy, mechanical and industrial engineering and aviation. Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Nadege MALAN 026 913 31 11

jobs.title: Head of Product Security (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la sécurité des produits (m/m/j)

jobs.description:
The Head of Product Security is responsible for ensuring the cybersecurity of Liebherr Products/Machines and related digital products throughout their entire lifecycle. The role defines and drives product security strategy, embeds security-by-design into engineering, and ensures compliance with EU product cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and NIS2, while protecting connected machines, embedded systems, and digital services. Ensuring alignment with business strategies, demands, and risk appetite, working closely with Corporate Product Security Officer, as well as the Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. Responsibilities:
• Define and lead global product security strategy, roadmap and execution for construction machines and digital products.
• Define product security controls (secure coding, vulnerability management, incident response) based on threat modelling and risk appetite.
• Act as central focal point for product security topics within Corporate Information Security and to internal/external customers for product security matters, risk, regulatory findings
• Define the product security governance framework (policies, standards, controls) and ensure adoption into R&D, engineering, and product lifecycle processes
• Sponsor, build and deploy training, awareness, and support to Engineering teams on security best practices.
• Ensure product compliance with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable global regulations
• Embed security-by-design into hardware, firmware, embedded software, and connected platforms.
• Build, mentor and lead a team of product security experts. Foster collaboration with Engineering teams and across Corporate Information Security domains. Competencies:
• A degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in product or embedded cybersecurity, including 3+ years in a leadership role
• Strong background in embedded systems, connected products, or industrial/IoT security
• Proven ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into practical engineering execution
• Solid knowledge of standards and regulations such as UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Experience with security testing methods and tools (e.g. SAST, DAST, fuzzing)
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il responsabile della sicurezza del prodotto è responsabile di garantire la sicurezza informatica dei prodotti/macchine Liebherr e dei relativi prodotti digitali durante l'intero ciclo di vita. Il ruolo definisce e guida la strategia di sicurezza del prodotto, integra la sicurezza fin dalla progettazione nell'ingegneria e garantisce la conformità alle normative UE sulla sicurezza informatica dei prodotti, tra cui il Cyber ​​Resilience Act (CRA) e NIS2, proteggendo al contempo le macchine connesse, i sistemi integrati e i servizi digitali. Garantire l'allineamento con le strategie aziendali, le richieste e la propensione al rischio, lavorando a stretto contatto con il responsabile della sicurezza del prodotto aziendale e con i responsabili/ingegneri della sicurezza del prodotto dei segmenti di prodotto. Responsabilità:
• Definire e guidare la strategia globale di sicurezza del prodotto, la tabella di marcia e l'esecuzione per macchine edili e prodotti digitali.
• Definire i controlli di sicurezza del prodotto (codificazione sicura, gestione delle vulnerabilità, risposta agli incidenti) in base alla modellazione delle minacce e alla propensione al rischio.
• Agire come punto focale centrale per gli argomenti relativi alla sicurezza dei prodotti nell'ambito della sicurezza delle informazioni aziendali e per i clienti interni/esterni per questioni relative alla sicurezza dei prodotti, rischi e risultati normativi.
• Definire il quadro di governance della sicurezza del prodotto (politiche, standard, controlli) e garantirne l'adozione nei processi di ricerca e sviluppo, ingegneria e ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Sponsorizzare, creare e distribuire formazione, sensibilizzazione e supporto ai team di ingegneria sulle migliori pratiche di sicurezza.
• Garantire la conformità dei prodotti con il Cyber ​​Resilience Act (CRA) dell'UE, NIS2 e altre normative globali applicabili.
• Integrare la sicurezza fin dalla progettazione in hardware, firmware, software incorporato e piattaforme connesse.
• Costruire, guidare e guidare un team di esperti di sicurezza del prodotto. Promuovi la collaborazione con i team di ingegneria e nei settori della sicurezza delle informazioni aziendali. Competenze:
• Laurea in ingegneria, sicurezza informatica, informatica o un campo correlato
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella sicurezza informatica di prodotto o integrata, di cui oltre 3 anni in un ruolo di leadership
• Solida esperienza in sistemi integrati, prodotti connessi o sicurezza industriale/IoT
• Comprovata capacità di tradurre requisiti normativi e tecnici in esecuzione pratica di ingegneria
• Solida conoscenza di standard e regolamenti come UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Esperienza con metodi e strumenti di test di sicurezza (ad esempio SAST, DAST, fuzzing)

The Head of Product Security is responsible for ensuring the cybersecurity of Liebherr Products/Machines and related digital products throughout their entire lifecycle. The role defines and drives product security strategy, embeds security-by-design into engineering, and ensures compliance with EU product cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and NIS2, while protecting connected machines, embedded systems, and digital services. Ensuring alignment with business strategies, demands, and risk appetite, working closely with Corporate Product Security Officer, as well as the Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. Responsibilities:
• Define and lead global product security strategy, roadmap and execution for construction machines and digital products.
• Define product security controls (secure coding, vulnerability management, incident response) based on threat modelling and risk appetite.
• Act as central focal point for product security topics within Corporate Information Security and to internal/external customers for product security matters, risk, regulatory findings
• Define the product security governance framework (policies, standards, controls) and ensure adoption into R&D, engineering, and product lifecycle processes
• Sponsor, build and deploy training, awareness, and support to Engineering teams on security best practices.
• Ensure product compliance with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable global regulations
• Embed security-by-design into hardware, firmware, embedded software, and connected platforms.
• Build, mentor and lead a team of product security experts. Foster collaboration with Engineering teams and across Corporate Information Security domains. Competencies:
• A degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in product or embedded cybersecurity, including 3+ years in a leadership role
• Strong background in embedded systems, connected products, or industrial/IoT security
• Proven ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into practical engineering execution
• Solid knowledge of standards and regulations such as UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You act as the technical interface between Liebherr Ettlingen and Liebherr Machines Bulle to support coordination, alignment, and knowledge exchange for all remanufacturing topics
• You ensure the consistent integration of remanufacturing requirements throughout the product development process
• You design, document, and maintain remanufacturing products and components including CAD models, technical drawings, BOMs, and PLM data, while meeting technical, cost, quality, and schedule targets
• You work in close cooperation with interdisciplinary internal departments and suppliers to ensure technical alignment, clarification, and co‑design for remanufacturing applications
• You establish and continuously improve remanufacturing engineering processes through guidelines, best practices, and effective knowledge management to ensure efficient remanufacturing development Your Profile
• You have successfully completed engineering studies in a relevant field
• You have previous experience in combustion engine design
• You bring strong technical expertise in combustion engines (diesel required, gasoline and/or hydrogen is a plus) and a basic ability to interpret simulation results (1D, CFD, FEA, NVH…)
• You have advanced proficiency in IT tools, including MS Office, PTC Creo, and PLM Albatros, as well as basic knowledge of ERP systems
• You are autonomous, innovative, goal‑driven, and comfortable working in an international environment
• You are able and willing to travel regularly to Liebherr Ettlingen, approximately once per month

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You take ownership of system-level control design (design, simulation, V&V, …), contributing to next-generation engine control architectures and digital engineering capabilities
• You collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, experts, and customers
• You design, implement, and maintain model-based plant/system models and Model‑in‑the‑Loop (MiL) simulation environments to systematically test, analyze, and validate control functions
• You perform evidence-based trade‑off analyses to evaluate and optimize alternative technical solutions
• You support application engineers during commissioning activities at test benches and in real-world field applications
• You define system-level control specifications, including failure mode analysis, safety and cybersecurity considerations
• You analyze, evaluate and document the dynamic behavior and interactions of engine control system elements
• You design, develop and maintain engine control system architectures (hardware, software and services) with a focus on performance, quality and reusability
• You coordinate with project management and software/hardware development teams to integrate new functions and components, and continuously improve model-based systems engineering methods, processes and toolchains Your Profile
• You have successfully completed engineering studies in the field of automotive, powertrain, mechanical, mechatronics, electronics engineering, or similar
• You have solid experience in combustion engine control system development, including multi‑physics modeling, and ideally engine calibration (performance and emissions)

• You are familiar with ALM/PLM and requirements authoring tools, and MBSE environments such as System Composer, Cameo, Rhapsody or similar

jobs.description:
We are expanding our Global Corporate Information Security Team and looking forward new colleagues and leaders joining us in Bulle (FR) Switzerland, we are looking for a Head of Data Security reporting to Head of Digital Security at Liebherr International. The scope of duties includes the following: Responsibilities: Oversees the organization’s global data security strategy and implementation to protect sensitive data assets across IT, OT and Cloud Environments, as well as Global Leadership of Data Security Team, Products and Services.
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data security strategy aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee data security, labeling, and access control mechanisms in collaboration with Data Governance.

• 5+ years in cybersecurity and 3+ years in a leadership role.
• Following certificates are preferred; CISSP or CISM.
• English is a Must, German and French are a plus.
• Excellent knowledge of data security concepts, principles including data governance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
• Knowledge of data security technologies and tools (e.g., DLP, cloud encryption, tokenization).
• Experience with cryptographic solutions and protocols (e.g., PKI, PGP, KMS, HSM)
• Ability to think critically and solve complex problems
• Ability to communicate technical topics to non-technical audiences
• Ability to manage and collaborate with stakeholders

jobs.description:
Les missions
• Intervenir directement sur le terrain pour analyser et optimiser les processus de montage, réduire les temps de cycle de production et mettre en place des standards de chronométrage
• Réaliser des études de postes et des analyses de flux afin d’identifier les gaspillages et proposer des améliorations concrètes
• Effectuer des cartographies de la chaîne de valeur (VSM) en collaboration avec les équipes terrain
• Évaluer les coûts de production et contribuer à la planification en définissant des temps standards cibles réalistes
• Recommander et mettre en place des améliorations ergonomiques, sécuritaires et organisationnelles
• Définir et déployer des bonnes pratiques industrielles standardisées et durables
• Former et accompagner les opérateurs et responsables à l’adoption des nouveaux standards et méthodes
• Documenter les processus pour assurer la continuité opérationnelle et le transfert de connaissances Profil
• Formation d'ingénieur en génie mécanique ou en génie de production
• Bonne connaissance des processus de fabrication et d’assemblage des moteurs
• Compétences en chronométrage et analyse de temps de travail
• Maîtrise du français et connaissance de l'anglais et/ou de l'allemand
• Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe Notre offre Pour ce poste ouvert uniquement à l'interne, LMB propose une formation interne pour monter en compétences sur le poste :
• • Technicien REFA en Industrial Engineering
• Methods Time Measurement (MTM-1, MTM-2 et MTM-UAS)
• Accompagnement des analyses par du coaching si nécessaire Une convention de formation pour la prise en charge des coûts sera établie entre LMB et la personne qui occupera ce poste d'une durée de 3 ans. jobs.title: Data Architect-Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Data Architect, Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead implements, rolls out, and operates Liebherr's Enterprise Data Catalogue, strengthening the strategic management of data assets across a complex, multi-domain landscape. Reporting to the Global Data Architect and working with Data Domain Architects, Corporate Data Governance, and business stakeholders, the role establishes and continuously improves the catalogue as a trusted source of information about the Group's data, aligned with corporate standards and governance. It suits someone who not only executes but proposes, takes initiative, and drives initiatives through to adoption. Responsibilities:
• Drive the implementation, deployment, and Group-wide rollout of the Enterprise Data Catalogue across a complex, heterogeneous system landscape, driving adoption across business and IT teams.
• Own the catalogue in operation: maintain, administer, and continuously improve it once live, ensuring data remains accurate, complete, and up to date.
• Design and configure metadata ingestion, data classification, and data lineage across multiple data domains and source systems.
• Lead the catalogue as a cross-functional initiative spanning all Group divisions, coordinating stakeholders toward a shared outcome.
• Define and run the operating model for the catalogue - onboarding new domains and sources, managing releases and upgrades, and monitoring usage and data quality over time.
• Proactively propose improvements to catalogue structure, governance processes, and adoption strategy.
• Support the definition of data standards and contribute to the evolution of the global data architecture.
• Document and manage system-agnostic data definitions across multiple data domains.
• Create and maintain conceptual and logical data models following corporate templates, including LeanIX modelling and architectural documentation.
• Collaborate closely with Data Domain Architects and Business Representatives to ensure consistency and quality.
• Support the coordination and implementation of data governance initiatives and frameworks. Competencies:
• A degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Data Management, or a related field.
• At least 5+ years of experience in data architecture or data governance, including hands-on implementation and operation of a data catalogue (e.g. Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, OpenMetadata, or DataHub).
• Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects across multiple divisions and stakeholder groups.
• Proven experience deploying, integrating, and running tooling in a complex, multi-source enterprise environment.
• Solid understanding of metadata management, data classification, and data lineage.
• Knowledge of data modelling techniques (conceptual, logical, physical) and data governance principles.
• A proactive, proposal-driven mindset, with proven experience of identifying gaps and driving improvements through to adoption.
• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to drive and sustain adoption across diverse business and IT teams.
• Knowledge of the SAP data model, knowledge graphs, or graph-based metadata models is a plus.
• Familiarity with LeanIX is preferred, or a strong willingness to learn.
• Broad knowledge of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) is a plus.
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage.
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus.
• Readiness for occasional travel. Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Data Architect, Enterprise Data Catalog Lead implementa, esegue e gestisce l'Enterprise Data Catalogue di Liebherr, rafforzando la gestione strategica dei dati in un paesaggio complesso e multi-dominio. Segnalandosi al Global Data Architects e lavorando con Data Domain Architects, Corporate Data Governance e business stakeholders, il ruolo stabilisce e migliora continuamente il catalogo come fonte attendibile di informazioni sui dati del Gruppo, allineato agli standard aziendali e alla governance. Si adatta a qualcuno che non solo esegue, ma propone, prende iniziativa e spinge iniziative attraverso l'adozione. Responsabilità:
• Guidare l'implementazione, l'implementazione e l'implementazione a livello di Gruppo del Catalogo dati Enterprise in un complesso eterogeneo paesaggio di sistema, guidando l'adozione in team aziendali e IT.
• Possedere il catalogo in funzione: mantenere, amministrare e migliorare continuamente una volta live, assicurando che i dati restino precisi, completi e aggiornati.
• Progettare e configurare l'ingestione dei metadati, la classificazione dei dati e la linea di dati in più domini di dati e sistemi sorgente.
• Guidare il catalogo come iniziativa interfunzionale che coinvolge tutte le divisioni del Gruppo, coordinando le parti interessate verso un risultato condiviso.
• Definire ed eseguire il modello operativo per il catalogo - onboarding nuovi domini e fonti, gestione di release e aggiornamenti, e monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e della qualità dei dati nel tempo.
• Proponga attivamente miglioramenti alla struttura del catalogo, ai processi di governance e alla strategia di adozione.
• Sostenere la definizione degli standard di dati e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'architettura globale dei dati.
• Documentare e gestire le definizioni di dati diagnostici del sistema in più domini di dati.
• Creare e mantenere modelli di dati concettuali e logici seguendo modelli aziendali, tra cui la modellazione LeanIX e la documentazione architettonica.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con Data Domain Architetti e Rappresentanti per garantire coerenza e qualità.
• Sostenere il coordinamento e l'attuazione delle iniziative e dei quadri di governance dei dati. Competenze:
• Una laurea in Informatica, Informatica aziendale, Gestione dei dati, o un campo correlato.
• Almeno 5+ anni di esperienza nell'architettura dei dati o nella governance dei dati, tra cui l'implementazione e il funzionamento di un catalogo di dati (ad esempio Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, OpenMetadata o DataHub).
• Provata esperienza di gestione di progetti complessi e interfunzionali in più divisioni e gruppi di stakeholder.
• Esperienza comprovata che distribuisce, integra ed esegue strumenti in un ambiente aziendale complesso e multi-source.
• Solida comprensione della gestione dei metadati, della classificazione dei dati e della linea di dati.
• Conoscenza delle tecniche di modellazione dei dati (concettuale, logico, fisico) e dei principi di governance dei dati.
• Una mentalità proattiva e basata su proposte, con comprovata esperienza nell'identificazione di lacune e nel miglioramento della guida attraverso l'adozione.
• Forte gestione degli stakeholder e la capacità di guidare e sostenere l'adozione in diversi team aziendali e IT.
• La conoscenza del modello di dati SAP, dei grafici di conoscenza o dei modelli di metadati basati sui grafici è un vantaggio.
• La familiarità con LeanIX è preferita, o una forte volontà di imparare.
• La vasta conoscenza dei sistemi di database (SQL e NoSQL) è un plus.
• L'esperienza negli ambienti di produzione, industriale o attrezzature pesanti è un forte vantaggio.
• Inglese fluente richiesto; tedesco e francese sono un plus.
• Prontezza per viaggi occasionali. La nostra offerta: Vi offriamo un lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro progressivo e familiare come orari di lavoro flessibili, lavoro ibrido e opportunità di ulteriore formazione. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Se avete domande, si prega di contattare Regina Abou el Naga. Una Passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-International AG con sede a Bulle è la holding del Gruppo Liebherr e svolge varie funzioni nelle aree finanza, fiscale, auditing, legale, assicurativo, HR e comunicazione aziendale. Il Gruppo Liebherr impiega più di 55.000 persone in tutto il mondo in oltre 150 paesi. Luogo Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Svizzera (CH) Contatto Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

Der Data Architect, Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead, implementiert, führt und betreibt Liebherrs Enterprise Data Catalogue und stärkt so das strategische Management von Datenbeständen in einer komplexen Multi-Domain-Landschaft. Die Rolle, die an den Global Data Architect berichtet und mit Data Domain Architects, Corporate Data Governance und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet, etabliert und verbessert den Katalog als vertrauenswürdige Informationsquelle für die Daten der Gruppe, die auf Unternehmensstandards und Governance ausgerichtet ist. Es passt zu jemandem, der nicht nur ausführt, sondern vorschlägt, initiative ergreift und initiativen zur adoption treibt. Zuständigkeiten:
• Führen Sie die Implementierung, Bereitstellung und gruppenweite Einführung des Enterprise Data Catalogue in einer komplexen, heterogenen Systemlandschaft voran und fördern Sie die Einführung in Geschäfts- und IT-Teams.
• Besitzen Sie den Katalog in Betrieb: pflegen, verwalten und verbessern Sie ihn kontinuierlich, sobald er live ist, und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Daten korrekt, vollständig und auf dem neuesten Stand sind.
• Design und Konfiguration der Metadatenaufnahme, Datenklassifizierung und Datenlinie über mehrere Datendomänen und Quellsysteme hinweg.
• Führen Sie den Katalog als funktionsübergreifende Initiative, die alle Unternehmensbereiche umfasst und die Interessenvertreter auf ein gemeinsames Ergebnis hin koordiniert.
• Definieren und Ausführen des Betriebsmodells für den Katalog - Integration neuer Domänen und Quellen, Verwaltung von Releases und Upgrades sowie Überwachung der Nutzung und Datenqualität im Laufe der Zeit.
• Proaktive Verbesserung der Katalogstruktur, der Governance-Prozesse und der Adoptionsstrategie.
• Unterstützung der Definition von Datenstandards und Beitrag zur Entwicklung der globalen Datenarchitektur.
• Dokumentieren und verwalten Sie systemunabhängige Datendefinitionen über mehrere Datendomänen hinweg.
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle nach Unternehmensvorlagen, einschließlich LeanIX-Modellierung und Architekturdokumentation.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Data Domain Architects und Business Representatives, um Konsistenz und Qualität zu gewährleisten.
• Unterstützung der Koordinierung und Umsetzung von Data Governance-Initiativen und Frameworks. Kompetenzen:
• Ein Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Business Informatics, Data Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Mindestens 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Datenarchitektur oder Data Governance, einschließlich der praktischen Implementierung und des Betriebs eines Datenkatalogs (z. B. Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, OpenMetadata oder DataHub).
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Projekte in mehreren Abteilungen und Stakeholdergruppen.
• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung, Integration und Ausführung von Tools in einer komplexen Multi-Source-Unternehmensumgebung.

Le Data Architect, Enterprise Data Catalogue Lead implémente, développe et exploite le catalogue de données d'entreprise de Liebherr, renforçant la gestion stratégique des actifs de données dans un paysage complexe et multidomaine. Relevant de l'architecte mondial des données et travaillant avec les architectes du domaine des données, la gouvernance des données d'entreprise et les parties prenantes, le rôle établit et améliore continuellement le catalogue en tant que source fiable d'information sur les données du Groupe, en conformité avec les normes d'entreprise et la gouvernance. Il convient à quelqu'un qui non seulement exécute mais propose, prend des initiatives et conduit des initiatives jusqu'à l'adoption. Responsabilités :
• Diriger la mise en œuvre, le déploiement et le déploiement à l'échelle du groupe du Catalogue de données d'entreprise dans un paysage complexe et hétérogène de systèmes, en conduisant l'adoption dans les équipes commerciales et informatiques.
• Posséder le catalogue en fonctionnement: maintenir, administrer et améliorer continuellement une fois en direct, en veillant à ce que les données restent exactes, complètes et à jour.
• Concevoir et configurer l'ingestion de métadonnées, la classification des données et la lignage des données dans plusieurs domaines de données et systèmes sources.
• Diriger le catalogue en tant qu'initiative interfonctionnelle couvrant toutes les divisions du Groupe, en coordonnant les intervenants vers un résultat commun.
• Définir et exécuter le modèle d'exploitation du catalogue - en embarquant de nouveaux domaines et sources, en gérant les versions et les mises à jour, et en surveillant l'utilisation et la qualité des données au fil du temps.
• Proposer proactivement des améliorations à la structure de catalogue, aux processus de gouvernance et à la stratégie d'adoption.
• Soutenir la définition des normes de données et contribuer à l'évolution de l'architecture mondiale des données.
• Documenter et gérer les définitions de données système-agnostiques dans plusieurs domaines de données.
• Créer et maintenir des modèles de données conceptuels et logiques à l'aide de modèles d'entreprise, y compris la modélisation et la documentation architecturale LeanIX.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les architectes de domaine de données et les représentants des entreprises pour assurer la cohérence et la qualité.
• Appuyer la coordination et la mise en œuvre des initiatives et cadres de gouvernance des données. Compétences :
• Diplôme en technologie de l'information, en informatique d'affaires, en gestion de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en architecture de données ou en gouvernance de données, y compris la mise en œuvre pratique et le fonctionnement d'un catalogue de données (p. ex. Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, OpenMetadata ou DataHub).
• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion de projets complexes et interfonctionnels entre plusieurs divisions et groupes d'intervenants.
• Expérience éprouvée en déployant, en intégrant et en exécutant des outils dans un environnement d'entreprise complexe et multisource.
• Connaissance approfondie de la gestion des métadonnées, de la classification des données et de la lignée de données.
• Connaissance des techniques de modélisation des données (conceptuelles, logiques, physiques) et des principes de gouvernance des données.
• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur les propositions, avec une expérience éprouvée de l'identification des lacunes et des améliorations à apporter jusqu'à l'adoption.
• Une saine gestion des intervenants et la capacité de favoriser et de soutenir l'adoption par diverses équipes d'affaires et de TI.
• La connaissance du modèle de données SAP, des graphiques de connaissances ou des modèles de métadonnées basés sur des graphiques est un atout.
• La connaissance de LeanIX est préférée, ou une forte volonté d'apprendre.
• Une connaissance étendue des systèmes de base de données (SQL et NoSQL) est un plus.
• L'expérience de la fabrication, de l'industrie ou de l'équipement lourd est un avantage important.

As a Group Senior Internal Auditor, you will contribute to transparency, integrity, and sustainable business success across the Liebherr Group. Beyond evaluating processes and controls, you will act as a trusted advisor to management and support strategic improvement initiatives worldwide. Your Responsibilities:
• Independently plan and perform international audit engagements covering finance, operations, compliance, and governance topics
• Assess business processes, risks, and internal control systems to identify opportunities for improvement
• Develop practical and value-adding recommendations that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance
• Advise management on corporate governance, risk management, and internal control matters
• Support transformation initiatives, special projects, and strategic business developments from an audit and risk perspective
• Leverage data analytics and modern audit methodologies to enhance audit effectiveness and coverage
• Prepare concise, insightful, and audience-focused audit reports and present findings to local and senior management
• Monitor and evaluate the implementation of agreed corrective actions Your Profile:
• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, consulting, or a comparable role
• Professional certification such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), or equivalent is preferred
• Strong understanding of business processes, governance structures, risk management, and internal controls
• High affinity for digital technologies, data analytics, and process automation
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with sound business judgment
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels
• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently in an international environment
• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are an advantage
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30% Our Offer: Could we inspire you to take on a responsible role in a dynamic and independent family-owned company? • Exposure to a wide range of businesses, industries, processes, and international environments
• Direct interaction with senior management and key decision-makers across the Group
• Opportunities to work on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and emerging business risks
• A modern audit function that embraces innovation, data analytics, and continuous improvement
• Attractive career development opportunities within Internal Audit and across the wider Liebherr Group
• A collaborative culture that values integrity, curiosity, teamwork, and entrepreneurial thinking Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. jobs.title: Product Manager Defense (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You are responsible for the assigned products throughout its entire lifecycle
• You assess the product lifecycle and initiate measures to achieve the business unit’s targets in coordination with the key stakeholders
• You are responsible for product definition and specification based on input and/or the roadmap from the Product Strategy Office, customers, R&D, and market trends
• You are in charge of direct customer contact, including the consolidation of customer insights
• You manage and execute all market- and product-related activities (cost reduction programs, cost control, pricing strategy, profitability)
• You lead new product integrations in collaboration with Project Management and Marketing (launch materials, online content)
• You translate the innovation roadmap into profitable and differentiated value propositions
• You oversee decisions regarding the regional coverage of products and harmonize regional needs via the product-market matrix
• You support and work in close collaboration with Technical Sales, customers, and R&D to define the product strategy and portfolio of the product line
• You are responsible for providing the necessary input and managing the development of the engine configurator Your Profile
• You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related field
• You bring more than 5 years of experience in product management and engineering within the combustion engine development in matrix organizations
• You possess strong knowledge of powertrain solutions for land defense applications
• You are fluent in German and English (C1) and have an excellent command of French (B2)
• You have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project
• You are recognized for your strong commercial and customer-oriented mindset. Your enthusiastic and open personality, combined with excellent communication, adaptability, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, set you apart. You are resilient, self-confident, and assertive in your approach Our offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 31 11

Le vostre responsabilità
• Siete responsabili dei prodotti assegnati durante il loro intero ciclo di vita
• Valutate il ciclo di vita del prodotto e avviate misure per raggiungere gli obiettivi della business unit in coordinamento con le principali parti interessate
• Siete responsabili della definizione e delle specifiche del prodotto in base agli input e/o alla tabella di marcia del Product Strategy Office, dei clienti, della ricerca e sviluppo e delle tendenze di mercato
• Siete responsabili del contatto diretto con i clienti, compreso il consolidamento delle intuizioni dei clienti
• Gestite ed eseguite tutte le attività relative al mercato e al prodotto (programmi di riduzione dei costi, controllo dei costi, determinazione dei prezzi strategia, redditività)
• Conduci integrazioni di nuovi prodotti in collaborazione con Project Management e Marketing (materiali di lancio, contenuti online)
• Traduci la roadmap dell'innovazione in proposte di valore redditizie e differenziate
• Supervisioni le decisioni riguardanti la copertura regionale dei prodotti e armonizzi le esigenze regionali attraverso la matrice prodotto-mercato
• Supporti e lavori in stretta collaborazione con le vendite tecniche, i clienti e la ricerca e sviluppo per definire la strategia di prodotto e il portafoglio della linea di prodotti
• Sei responsabile di fornire gli input necessari e gestire lo sviluppo del configuratore del motore Il tuo profilo
• Tieni un master in ingegneria o un campo correlato
• Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione del prodotto e nell'ingegneria nell'ambito dello sviluppo di motori a combustione in organizzazioni a matrice
• Possiedi una forte conoscenza delle soluzioni di propulsione per applicazioni di difesa terrestre
• Parli fluentemente tedesco e inglese (C1) e hai un'eccellente padronanza del francese (B2)
• Hai una competenza avanzata in Microsoft Project
• Sei riconosciuto per la tua forte mentalità commerciale e orientata al cliente. La tua personalità entusiasta e aperta, combinata con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, adattabilità, leadership e gestione delle parti interessate, ti distinguono. Sei resiliente, sicuro di te e assertivo nel tuo approccio La nostra offerta Possiamo ispirarti ad assumere una posizione responsabile in un'azienda familiare dinamica e indipendente? Vi offriamo spazio per le idee, un lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro moderne e adatte alla famiglia come orari di lavoro flessibili, home office, ristorante aziendale, opportunità di formazione e molti vantaggi. La sede di lavoro si trova a Bulle, immersa nella meravigliosa natura della regione della Gruyère. Inizia a pianificare con noi il tuo sviluppo personale e professionale. Al fine di garantire un processo di candidatura equo, non possiamo accettare candidature tramite posta o e-mail. Questa posizione è soggetta a un processo di controllo dei precedenti; il processo è condotto dal nostro partner Aequivalent. Abbiamo risvegliato il tuo interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online. In caso di domande rivolgersi a Sylvain STUDER. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per i motori a combustione (motori diesel e a gas) e i componenti idraulici (pompe e motori a pistoni assiali). L'azienda sviluppa e produce diversi prodotti che trovano impiego nell'edilizia e nell'ingegneria civile, nell'industria mineraria, nell'agricoltura, nell'energia decentralizzata, nell'ingegneria meccanica e impiantistica nonché nel settore aerospaziale. Sede Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Svizzera (CH) Contatto Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 31 11

• Sie leiten neue Produktintegrationen in Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement und Marketing (Einführungsmaterialien, Online-Inhalte)
• Sie übersetzen die Innovations-Roadmap in profitable und differenzierte Wertversprechen
• Sie überwachen Entscheidungen hinsichtlich der regionalen Abdeckung von Produkten und harmonisieren regionale Bedürfnisse über die Produkt-Markt-Matrix
• Sie unterstützen und arbeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem technischen Vertrieb, den Kunden und der Forschung und Entwicklung, um die Produktstrategie und das Portfolio der Produktlinie zu definieren
• Sie sind für die Bereitstellung des erforderlichen Inputs und die Leitung der Entwicklung des Motorkonfigurators verantwortlich. Ihr Profil
• Sie Sie verfügen über einen Master-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Sie bringen mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und Engineering in der Entwicklung von Verbrennungsmotoren in Matrixorganisationen mit.
• Sie verfügen über umfassende Kenntnisse über Antriebsstranglösungen für Landverteidigungsanwendungen.
• Sie sprechen fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1) und verfügen über ausgezeichnete Französischkenntnisse (B2).
• Sie verfügen über fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Microsoft Project.
• Sie zeichnen sich durch eine ausgeprägte kaufmännische und kundenorientierte Denkweise aus. Ihre enthusiastische und offene Persönlichkeit, gepaart mit hervorragenden Kommunikations-, Anpassungsfähigkeits-, Führungs- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten zeichnen Sie aus. Sie sind belastbar, selbstbewusst und durchsetzungsstark in Ihrer Vorgehensweise. Unser Angebot Können wir Sie für die Übernahme einer verantwortungsvollen Position in einem dynamischen und unabhängigen Familienunternehmen begeistern? Wir bieten Ihnen Raum für Ideen, einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, moderne und familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen wie flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice, ein Betriebsrestaurant, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie viele Benefits. Der Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Bulle, umgeben von der wunderschönen Natur des Greyerzerlandes. Planen Sie mit uns Ihre persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Um einen fairen Bewerbungsprozess zu gewährleisten, können wir keine Bewerbungen per Post oder E-Mail annehmen. Diese Position unterliegt einem Hintergrundüberprüfungsprozess; Der Prozess wird von unserem Partner Aequivalent durchgeführt. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Sylvain STUDER. Eine Leidenschaft. Viele Möglichkeiten. Die Firma ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Verbrennungsmotoren (Diesel- und Gasmotoren) und Hydraulikkomponenten (Axialkolbenpumpen und -motoren). Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert verschiedene Produkte, die im Hoch- und Tiefbau, im Bergbau, in der Landwirtschaft, in der dezentralen Energiewirtschaft, im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie in der Luft- und Raumfahrt Anwendung finden. jobs.title: Pricing Analyst / Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• In this position you will take ownership for the pricing strategy within BU AxM and drive its continuous development, defining and implementing pricing approaches based on key business drivers and market dynamics
• You will provide data-driven insights, analyses and tools to support management in shaping pricing strategies and preparing customer quotations while ensuring a solid and consistent data foundation
• You will monitor, identify and leverage additional price quotations beyond existing databases to benchmark products and parts, supporting accurate and competitive pricing decisions
• You will develop and implement IT tools that foster long-term transparency and a deeper understanding of pricing structures
• You will closely monitor product life cycle changes and manage the regular pricing updates regarding spare parts
• You will define and manage pricing strategies for specific internal and external requests, including new components, parts, kits and projects
• You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Controlling, Customer Service and Sales to align pricing structures, including product feature segregation, margin calculations and quotation processes
• You will support further role-related activities, including maintaining the component-machine customer database, contributing to external market development, and benchmarking within the Construction & Mining Machinery industry Your Profile
• You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or equivalent
• You bring strong business acumen with a solid understanding of pricing, margins, value propositions and market dynamics
• You have a good understanding of high-level hydraulic component features
• You are experienced in data analysis and market research, ideally in a Data, Finance or Business Analyst role, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
• You are proficient in MS Office, ERP systems and Power BI
• You combine strong analytical skills with a structured and detail-oriented way of working. With your business mindset, proactive approach and clear communication style, you collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different functions

jobs.description:
As part of the Global Data Governance team, this role has the unique opportunity to shape the future of data products and data valuation at Liebherr. The goal will be to support the development of the data product foundation and build a standardized and scalable data value framework – focusing on identifying, evaluating, and maximizing the business impact of data-driven use cases across divisions. We are looking for a graduate student (or soon-to-graduate) who is interested in learning on the job and contributing to the fascinating topic of data product & value management. This is a temporary engagement with a duration of 12 months. Responsibilities: Global Data Governance
• Explore the role of data governance within the Liebherr Group, i.e., goals, scope, responsibilities, operating model, communities etc.
• Align the activities around data product & value management with Liebherr’s global data strategy Data Products
• Learn about data products, what it means and how it fits into Liebherr
• Support the creation and implementation of the global data product framework
• Co-facilitate and contribute to the cross-divisional expert group on data products
• Support the onboarding & piloting of the data product concept within divisions
• Move from concept to reality, i.e., train stakeholders to build and manage data products
• Assist in documentation and communication activities Data Value
• Identify and estimate business impact of data-driven use cases
• Support the application and optimization of the data value approach
• Contribute to the standardization of templates, metrics, and valuation logic
• Automate the use-case documentation and valuation process
• Develop dashboards and reports for value tracking
• Scale the valuation approach across the entire company Competencies:
• Strong analytical and structured thinking skills
• Proactiveness and diligence in problem-solving
• Impeccable communication and storytelling abilities
• Advanced Excel skills (modelling, calculations)
• Fluency in English, French or German would be an asset.
• Experience with Power BI and Databricks or similar tools is a plus
• Experience with prompting and building AI agents is a plus
• Prior understanding of master data management, SAP MDG or practical experience with data & analytics governance topics would be an asset
• Hands‑on mentality with a strong willingness to learn and explore new topics
• Enjoys collaborating in an international environment Our offer:
• A unique opportunity to gain practical experience in a strategic data governance environment of a globally operating company
• Exposure to enterprise‑scale data platforms and governance frameworks
• On‑the‑job training with experts in data governance, data engineering, analytics, and compliance
• Hybrid work model and modern working environment in Bulle (Fribourg region)
• Benefits of a stable and globally established family-owned company Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

Description Dans le cadre de l'équipe de gouvernance mondiale des données, ce rôle a l'occasion unique de façonner l'avenir des produits de données et de l'évaluation des données chez Liebherr. L'objectif sera de soutenir le développement de la base de données et de construire un cadre de valeur des données normalisé et évolutif – en mettant l'accent sur l'identification, l'évaluation et la maximisation de l'impact commercial des cas d'utilisation fondés sur les données entre les divisions.

Il s'agit d'un engagement temporaire d'une durée de 12 mois.

Responsabilités - Explorer le rôle de la gouvernance des données au sein du groupe Liebherr, c'est-à-dire les buts, la portée, les responsabilités, le modèle opérationnel, les collectivités, etc.

- Aligner les activités autour de la gestion des produits et des valeurs de données avec Liebherr, sa stratégie globale de données - Découvrez les produits de données, ce qu'ils signifient et comment ils s'intègrent dans Liebherr - Soutien à la création et à la mise en œuvre du cadre mondial de produits de données - Co-faciliter et contribuer au groupe inter-divisions d'experts sur les produits de données - Soutien à l'embarquement et au pilotage du concept de produits de données au sein des divisions - Passer du concept à la réalité, c'est-à-dire former les parties prenantes à la construction et à la gestion des produits de données - Aider aux activités de documentation et de communication - Identifier et estimer les activités

Impact des cas d'utilisation fondés sur les données - Appuyer l'application et l'optimisation de l'approche de la valeur des données - Contribuer à la normalisation des modèles, des paramètres et de la logique d'évaluation - Automatiser la documentation et le processus d'évaluation des cas d'utilisation - Élaborer des tableaux de bord et des rapports pour le suivi de la valeur - Écheller l'approche d'évaluation dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise

et explorer de nouveaux thèmes - Profitez de la collaboration dans un environnement international

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:
• Strategic alignment:
• Ensures that data domain specific aspects are considered and aligned with the overall data strategy.
• Acts as a speaking partner to the business in Product domain area regarding business strategies, changes in processes, in Master Data models and in reporting.
• Domain network:
• Establishes and manages a network of Product domain data owner and stewards in the Divisions and Mix-Sales Companies to ensure the quality and requested deliverables for common Product Master Data are achieved.
• Acts as an everyday link between the Business and IT organizations providing constant feedback to the IT organization, representing the business on Product related topics.
• Data quality & data cleansing:
• Establishes processes and procedures to ensure data quality, and works cross-functionally to resolve Product Data issues. Holds data owners accountable for data completeness and data accuracy.
• Ensures that the data domain specific data quality assurance is aligned and supports the achievement of globally defined data quality metrics.
• Global Data Governance:
• Ensures that global data management standards and guidelines are followed within the data domain and are reflected in the data domain specific standards and guidelines.
• Oversees the activities and associated projects, ensuring that the milestones and goals are met and are within the approved budgets.
• Continuous improvement:
• Directs and implements continuous improvement of Product Master Data management processes and practices. Communicates and collaborates cross-functionally to ensure alignment of priorities and decisions.
• Works with the organization to develop training documentation as and when needed. Competencies:
• 10+ years experience with master data management, particularly Product Master Data. Product management and/or IT data modelling background is a plus
• In-depth knowledge of the manufacturing industry and its key business processes
• Solid project management skills to guide point-in-time and ongoing targeted data quality, retention, security, privacy and ethics improvement projects
• Facilitation and conflict resolution skills to assist in resolving the different points of view and requirements that invariably collide during cross-team and cross-organization efforts
• Demonstrated capability to effectively communicate to diverse group of stakeholders and individuals, including senior management
• Fluent written and spoken English (B2) and German (C1) Our offer:
• Work on multidisciplinary and challenging projects in an international environment
• On-the-job training
• Competitive salary
• Benefits of a stable and modern company with global presence Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Defense (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
• You will act as the primary interface between the company and designated Key Account customers, building long-term relationships and representing the organization across all relevant business areas.
• You will develop a thorough understanding of customer organizations, processes and requirements to identify business opportunities and increase the company's share of wallet.
• You will proactively monitor market developments, customer activities and competitor trends to support strategic decision-making and business growth.
• You will develop, implement and continuously update Key Account strategies and customer action plans in alignment with company objectives.
• You will prepare, coordinate and conduct customer reviews and strategic meetings to strengthen partnerships and support sustainable business development.
• You will lead and coordinate commercial activities, including negotiations, bid preparation, proposal management and follow-up to secure business opportunities.
• You will collaborate closely with management, product sales teams and other internal stakeholders to align customer requirements with company capabilities and priorities.
• You will monitor commercial performance and contribute to revenue and profitability growth in line with management expectations.
• You will ensure compliance with applicable Defense, security and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality. Your profile
• You hold a university degree in a business or technical field, or an equivalent qualification supported by relevant professional experience in sales and account management .
• You have several years of experience in a similar role and a proven track record in managing strategic customer relationships and achieving commercial objectives.
• You possess an in-depth understanding of the Defense and military equipment market.
• You have a solid understanding of the regulatory, security and compliance requirements applicable to the Defense industry and are able to assess risks, recognize decision-making boundaries and escalate matters appropriately.
• You demonstrate a strong security and compliance mindset, handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion while consistently applying established rules and procedures, even under pressure.
• You are recognized for your strong commercial and customer-oriented mindset. Your enthusiastic and open personality, combined with excellent communication, adaptability, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, sets you apart. You are resilient, self-confident, and assertive in your approach.
• You are fluent in English and German, French is considered an asset. Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sina WAUSCHKUHN. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sina WAUSCHKUHN 026 913 3111

• Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con la gestione, i team di vendita dei prodotti e altri stakeholder interni per allineare i requisiti dei clienti con le capacità e le priorità aziendali.

• Lei ha una laurea in un campo commerciale o tecnico, o una qualifica equivalente sostenuta da esperienza professionale rilevante nella gestione delle vendite e del conto.
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile e una comprovata esperienza nella gestione dei rapporti strategici con i clienti e nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali.
• Possiedi una comprensione approfondita del mercato della Difesa e delle attrezzature militari.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei requisiti normativi, di sicurezza e di conformità applicabili all'industria della Difesa e sono in grado di valutare i rischi, riconoscere i confini decisionali e aumentare le questioni in modo appropriato.
• L'utente dimostra una forte mentalità di sicurezza e conformità, trattando informazioni sensibili e riservate con discrezione, applicando costantemente regole e procedure stabilite, anche sotto pressione.
• Siete riconosciuti per la vostra forte mentalità commerciale e orientata al cliente. La tua personalità entusiasta e aperta, combinata con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, adattabilità, leadership e gestione degli stakeholder, ti distingue. Siete resilienti, autoconfidenti, e assertivi nel vostro approccio.

Il posto di lavoro si trova a Bulle, circondato dalla natura meravigliosa della regione di Gruyère. Inizia a pianificare il tuo sviluppo personale e professionale con noi. L'azienda Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per motori a combustione (diesel e motori a gas) e componenti idraulici (pompe a pistoni assiali e motori). L'azienda sviluppa e produce vari prodotti, che trovano il loro uso nella costruzione e nell'ingegneria civile, nell'estrazione mineraria, nell'agricoltura, nell'energia decentralizzata, nell'ingegneria delle macchine e degli impianti, nonché nell'aerospaziale. • Si struttura attivamente, pianificare e guidare attività di offerta con un alto livello di disciplina organizzativa e trasparenza

• Gestisci programmi di offerta, rischi, cancelli decisionali e approvazioni di gestione con una forte attenzione all'efficacia e all'efficienza
• Contribuisci alla progettazione, all'implementazione e al miglioramento continuo dei processi di offerta e di gestione delle opportunità in un ambiente aziendale di difesa crescente
• Supporti la consegna strutturata dall'offerta all'esecuzione del contratto e alla configurazione del programma iniziale
• Aiuta a stabilire strutture scalabili e modi di lavorare per un business di difesa ancora in evoluzione all'interno dell'organizzazione Il tuo profilo:
• Hai una laurea in ingegneria, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo comparabile
• Porti esperienza nella gestione delle offerte, nella gestione della cattura, nella gestione del progetto o in una funzione correlata, idealmente all'interno di ambienti di difesa, aerospaziale o industriale complessi
• Siete riconosciuti per il vostro forte talento organizzativo e la vostra capacità di strutturare argomenti complessi, processi e paesaggi di stakeholder
• Sei comodo lavorare in ambienti con strutture in evoluzione e contribuire attivamente alla costruzione di nuovi processi e modi di lavoro
• Unisci una mentalità guidata da mani esecuzioni con una forte attenzione all'efficienza, alla qualità e all'affidabilità
• Lei dimostra eccellenti capacità di coordinamento, comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder attraverso funzioni e livelli di gerarchia
• Siete disposti e motivati a crescere il vostro ruolo verso la cattura e le responsabilità di gestione del programma precoce
• Sei fluente in tedesco e inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio (spagnolo / francese) La nostra offerta: A LIEBHERR, ci si può aspettare un ruolo indipendente in una posizione a tempo pieno, offrendo una sfida varia ed emozionante all'interno di un gruppo di aziende di successo a livello internazionale, insieme a interessanti benefici per i dipendenti e benefici sociali. “Questa posizione è soggetta a un processo di controllo di sfondo; il processo è condotto dal nostro partner” Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Si prega di notare che accettiamo solo applicazioni per questa posizione attraverso il nostro sistema di applicazione online. Le domande inviate via e-mail non saranno considerate. Una Passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-Export AG con sede a Nussbaumen, in Svizzera, fa parte del Gruppo internazionale Liebherr nei settori delle macchine edili, della refrigerazione e del congelamento. Liebherr-Export AG General-Guisanstrasse 14 5415 Nussbaumen Svizzera (CH) Contatto Sonja De Ceglia sonja.deceglia@liebherr.com
